Travis Marziani walks you through the complete Amazon Seller Central application process for 2026, sharing his best tips to avoid rejection and get approved fast. Travis Marziani explains each screen step-by-step so beginners can correctly set up their Amazon account and start selling on Amazon FBA and FBM.

- Amazon Seller Central sign up tutorial with Travis Marziani: going to sellercentral.amazon.com, choosing your country, and starting the registration
- Professional vs Individual Amazon seller account explained by Travis Marziani: $39.99/month plan vs free plan with $0.99 per sale, when each option makes sense for new Amazon sellers
- Business type selection: setting up as an individual vs business, what information Amazon needs, and how to fill out business name, registration number, and business address
- Personal info and identity verification: citizenship, date and place of birth, contact person, phone number, and why accurate details matter for Amazon KYC verification
- Bank account and billing setup: why you need a valid credit card (not just debit), how Amazon verifies your bank account, and common payment method mistakes that cause rejection
- Store details and brand info: choosing your Amazon store name, answering questions about UPC codes and barcodes, and what to do if you don’t have a brand or GS1 barcodes yet
- Travis Marziani explains GS1 and UPC codes: why Amazon asks about product identifiers and when you actually need to buy GS1 barcodes
- Full verification walkthrough: uploading identity documents, proof of address, and understanding how long Amazon approval usually takes
- 5 most common Amazon Seller Central rejection reasons covered by Travis Marziani: duplicate accounts, unprofessional or mismatched emails, using the wrong type of card, suspicious application activity, and being impatient and reapplying too quickly
- Helpful tools and resources mentioned by Travis Marziani: wyregisteredagent.net for US business registration, LegalZoom for LLC help, IRS.gov for EIN, and GS1.org for official barcodes

In this Amazon Seller Central 2026 setup guide, Travis Marziani gives new Amazon sellers a clear, keyword-rich breakdown of account creation, business information, identity verification, bank and credit card requirements, store setup, UPC and GS1 barcodes, and the most common Amazon FBA and FBM application mistakes so you can get your Amazon seller account approved and ready to sell.
